name: CBPAUP0J.jcl
description:
This JCL executes the CBPAUP0C program as an IMS Batch Message Processing (BMP) region using the PSBPAUTB Program Specification Block, designed to process card account updates within the CardDemo application. The program receives control parameters via SYSIN (00,00001,00001,Y) that govern the update processing range and behavior.Key Functionalities:
Executes an IMS BMP batch program (CBPAUP0C) to perform card account update processing using IMS database access controlled by the PSBPAUTB program specification block
Accepts inline control parameters (00,00001,00001,Y) via SYSIN to define processing criteria such as start/end record ranges and a processing flag, guiding the scope of account updates
Reads and updates IMS database segments for card account data as defined by the IMS PSB and DBD libraries, enabling structured batch maintenance of account records
Produces processing results, system messages, and any error or abend information to system output destinations for operational review

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Account Auto Update program (CBPAUP0C) is triggered in IMS Batch Message Processing mode with the following control parameters supplied via SYSIN: Processing Mode is set to '00' (Standard Full Processing), the account processing range is defined from start sequence '00001' to end sequence '00001', and the Processing Activation Flag is set to 'Y' (activate live updates). The program's IMS database access rights are governed by PSB PSBPAUTB, which authorizes read and write access to the relevant Card Account IMS database segments. IMS transaction logging is disabled (IEFRDER and IMSLOGR are set to inactive) for this run.
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The batch job is submitted and STEP01 executes unconditionally with no conditional branching or step-skip logic. The program reads the SYSIN control record, validates the Processing Activation Flag, determines the account range to process, and applies the authorized processing mode.
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program must: (1) Confirm the Processing Activation Flag is 'Y' and proceed with live database updates — if the flag were not 'Y', update execution would be bypassed; (2) Apply standard full processing logic (Mode '00') to all Card Account records within the specified range (sequence 00001 through 00001); (3) Access and update only the IMS database segments authorized under PSB PSBPAUTB; (4) Apply all updates directly to the IMS Card Account databases without generating an IMS transaction log; (5) Write all processing results, record counts, and status messages to the system print output (SYSPRINT and SYSOUT); (6) Report any IMS database access or update errors to the IMS error output destination (IMSERR); (7) Complete the step — the job has no recovery or retry branching logic, so successful completion or abnormal termination are the only two outcomes.

rules.Rule_Name: STEP01 - CBPAUP0C - Card Account Automated Batch Update Processing
rules.Rule_Description: This step invokes the Card Account Auto Update program (CBPAUP0C) through the IMS Batch Message Processing framework. The program performs automated updates to IMS-managed Card Account database records for a specified account range, controlled by inline processing parameters. The activation flag must be set to 'Y' to allow live updates to be applied. IMS transaction logging is disabled for this execution.
